description: The two pie charts represent the distribution of different categories, with the left chart showing four slices and the right chart showing four slices as well. The categories are labeled as "Atomic Skill Fail", "Correct", and "Reason Error", corresponding to distinct colors, with "Atomic Skill Fail" being dark blue, "Correct" being teal, and "Reason Error" being light blue and white. In the left chart, the slices are labeled as "Atomic Skill Fail" (8%, white), "Correct" (68%, teal), and two "Reason Error" slices (12% and 12%, light blue). The right chart has slices labeled as "Atomic Skill Fail" (10%, dark blue), "Correct" (55%, teal), "Reason Error" (21%, light blue), and an unlabeled slice (14%, white). Both charts include percentage labels inside the slices, and a legend is provided at the top to explain the color coding. The slices in both charts are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice appearing first.
